name: veo-match-analytics
description: Extract and verify Veo match analytics, resolve player links from fixture lineups with default rosters as backup, and save graph-ready team metrics plus confirmed player and event data to Supabase.

interface.shortDescription: Save Veo analytics and raw-video event links
interface.longDescription: Open a Veo match analysis URL in the browser or validate an intermediate JSON export from that exact page, pause for sign-in when required, inspect observed analytics, event, and media data, confirm the ClubATX fixture, corrected side mapping, official score, Veo-authoritative half duration, athlete links, event-link pre-roll, and destructive event replacement, then atomically persist and verify graph-ready team metrics, cumulative event minutes, consolidated player statistics, exact playing-time seconds, and supported player events linked to the raw MP4 recording with a 3-second playback pre-roll by default. Use fixture lineups first and default team rosters only as backup; unlinked jerseys are expected and should be reported neutrally.
defaultPrompt: Extract and save analytics from this Veo match URL
Import exact player playing times from this Veo match
Import player events with raw-video links and a 3-second pre-roll from this Veo match
